answer.short_answer:
ClinicalTrials.gov reports Asthma Control (8 weeks (from Week 0 to Week 8)) for Singulair(R) In Asthma And Allergic Rhinitis (0476-383): Week 0 (Treatment Phase (All Patients)): Uncontrolled: 312, Controlled: 0, Missing: 1; denominator 313 participants; Week 8 (Treatment Phase (All Patients)): Uncontrolled: 72, Controlled: 229, Missing: 0; denominator 301 participants. The registry describes the study as: Effectiveness of adding montelukast to inhaled corticosteroids in adult subjects with both uncontrolled asthma and allergic rhinitis. [ClinicalTrials.gov:NCT00545844]
